Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Validation rules — http://127.0.0.1:4370/validation
  2. Enter "abc" in Username
  3. Enter "17" in Age
  4. Enter "5000.00" in Amount

  7. Enter "0120120" in Phone
  8. Press "Validate"
  9. Check Confirm 17 (one step below the minimum of 18) was refused ← fails here
    Expected the submission to be refused, but it was accepted: the form is gone; no field is marked invalid; no error message is shown; confirmation: "Thank you. We received it. Reference VAL-0115." (now at http://127.0.0.1:4370/validation/done?ref=VAL-0115).

Test data

age17
phone0120120
amount5000.00
websitehttps://example.test/qa
quantity50
usernameabc

Expected

The form is not accepted and Age is reported as invalid.

Actual

Expected the submission to be refused, but it was accepted: the form is gone; no field is marked invalid; no error message is shown; confirmation: "Thank you. We received it. Reference VAL-0115." (now at http://127.0.0.1:4370/validation/done?ref=VAL-0115).

Where to look

The application accepted a value it should refuse for "age" (technique: min-1). The page declares the rule, so the browser would stop a normal user — but the server does not enforce it, and anything that skips the page's checks gets through. Add the same validation to the server-side handler and return an error tied to "age". (A starting point drawn from what the test observed, not a diagnosis of the code.)

BUG-14 · DEF-0002 (Proposed)

Transfer money: sends a submission more than once

Major Priority High Reliability and duplicates Application defect · 80% confidence

Found by TC-0490 (Transfer money: sends one submission when the submit control is pressed twice quickly), which fails at step 5: Confirm at most one POST was sent.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Transfer money — http://127.0.0.1:4370/duplicate-submit
  2. Enter "QA NXT test" in Payee
  3. Enter "500.50" in Amount
  4. Press "Send money" repeatedly
  5. Check Confirm at most one POST was sent ← fails here
    expected at most 1 POST submission(s) the server did not refuse but saw 2.

Test data

payeeQA NXT test
amount500.50

Expected

Exactly one submission reaches the server.

Actual

expected at most 1 POST submission(s) the server did not refuse but saw 2.

Where to look

The submission was sent more than once. Disable the submit control while the request is in flight, and make the endpoint idempotent (an idempotency key, or a unique constraint on the business key) so a repeat cannot create a second record. (A starting point drawn from what the test observed, not a diagnosis of the code.)
